individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the 141 points is an individual sample measurement, not an average.
Each point is a mean of ~6 replicate samples with s.d. error bars, but no individual replicate values are overlaid.
Line/density plot of fitted distributions; line plots are exempt from requiring individual points.
Box plot with individual Per2-Luc and Bmal1-Luc data points overlaid as dots.
Polar histograms display probability-normalized frequency distributions, not averages requiring overlaid individual points.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences shown as a distribution, exempt like other histogram-type plots.
Illustrative line plot of a single example signal and its fit, not an aggregated average requiring individual points.
Scatter plot where each of the 117 points is an individual sample's fitted parameters, with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty rather than replicate averaging.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Scatter plot with marginal histograms; no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean ± s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]).
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are present and explicitly defined as mean plus/minus s.d. in the caption.
Smooth fitted density curves with no error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box, whiskers, median, outliers) are all explicitly defined in the caption.
Polar histogram bars show probability-normalized frequencies; no error bars present.
Polar histogram with no error bars.
Example single-trace fit illustration; no error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are present and their meaning (s.d. of fitted parameters) is explicitly defined in the caption.
